name: harness-mem
description: Local-first AI memory runtime wrapper for Codex and Claude-style agent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Local AI memory for project context, search, wake-up, and task resume.
interface.longDescription: Wraps harness-mem as a plugin with a skill, MCP server config, and helper scripts. Use it to ingest local agent sessions, generate wake-up context, search prior work, and promote durable rules without moving data out of the local machine.
